purpose: Teach: めど/取組み/先着/借入金/略称/一級/推察/親密

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、事件解決のめどがついた
lines.en: We've made significant progress on the case.
lines.style: Clear, professional opening. Measured pace. Quiet authority—not rushing the news. A moment of pause before the statement lands.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、地域取組みを発表されたんですね
lines.en: I see. So the police have announced a new community initiative.
lines.style: Attentive nod in the voice. Slightly formal, respectful. Picking up on what was just shared. Warm acknowledgment without over-performing.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、防犯セミナーは先着順で実施しております
lines.en: The crime prevention seminars are open to the public on a first-come, first-served basis.
lines.style: Professional, informational tone. Even pacing. Precise—each detail given equal weight. The voice of someone delivering practical information clearly.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、借入金詐欺の事件をご捜査されてますね
lines.en: Yes. I understand you're also investigating the loan fraud case.
lines.style: Respectful inquiry. Gentle lean forward in the voice. Showing he's been listening, making space for more. Not pressing, just present.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、署の略称をご記憶ください
lines.en: Please remember the station's abbreviation for your records.
lines.style: Polite, instructional. Slight formality—the voice of someone who wants to be clear and helpful. Patient rhythm, like speaking to someone taking notes.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、一級資格を持つ捜査官、頼もしいです
lines.en: Yes. Having investigators with first-class credentials—that's reassuring.
lines.style: Genuine respect in the tone. Warm, not flattering. A small smile in the voice. Sincere recognition of competence.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、容疑者の心理を推察しております
lines.en: We're analyzing the suspect's psychological profile.
lines.style: Methodical, composed. The voice of someone thinking through a problem carefully. Steady breath. No rush. Technical but not cold.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察と地域の親密な連携、大事ですね
lines.en: Yes. The way police and community work together like that—it really does matter.
lines.style: Warm, genuine reflection. Slight nod in the tone. Slower pace on 'really does matter'—he means it. A moment of shared understanding.
